about: Behavior of every migrated flag parser, captured from the build at 7b09b77 (before the declarative flag tables). Each case: [parser, argument list, expected]. Expected is {ok: parsed value} or {error: {code, message, remedy}}; a flag that is missing its value, a doubled flag, a value starting with --, an empty value, --flag=value, an unknown flag and a positional all appear for each parser. help maps a command to the sha256 of its exact help output (stdout bytes).
